newsitem.title: UK: Gilts to creep higher, keep one eye on stg.
newsitem.headline: Gilts to creep higher, keep one eye on stg.

text.p: 0630 GMT - Gilts are expected to edge up at Wednesday's open. With little on the diary, the market will keep an eye on the pound although its near four percent fall in a week has yet to hurt gilts. Contract high of 115-25 unlikely to crack.
* September gilt future settled at 115-12 on Tuesday
